fluff.overview: The Marian military tradition places infantry at the foundation of its legionary system, with conventional soldiers organized into units bearing Latin designations that reflect the Hegemony's deliberate cultivation of Roman imperial identity. A centuria, or century, is the Marian equivalent of a company-sized formation. Mechanized tracked centuries ride armored personnel carriers that trade speed for all-terrain capability, providing reliable transport across the rough ground common to many Hegemony garrison worlds. Equipped with laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these formations field one of the most effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons require soldiers to carry additional power packs.
